Web Developer (WordPress / E-Commerce)
Harbourview Studio

Who we are

Harbourview Studio is a boutique web agency in Mississauga serving retail, hospitality, and professional-services clients across the GTA. We design, build, and maintain WordPress and WooCommerce sites, plus the occasional Shopify build.

The role

- Build custom WordPress themes from scratch (PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript) — no page-builder-only work
- Develop and extend WooCommerce stores: product types, checkout customization, payment and shipping integrations
- Maintain a portfolio of ~30 client sites: updates, security patches, performance tuning
- Implement technical SEO improvements and Core Web Vitals fixes
- Build landing pages and email templates for client campaigns
- Scope small projects directly with clients and estimate your own work
- Occasional Shopify theme work (Liquid) for our e-commerce clients

Must have

- 2+ years of professional WordPress development experience
- Solid PHP fundamentals and comfort reading plugin source code
- Strong JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 skills
- Experience with WooCommerce or another e-commerce platform in production
- Experience with responsive design and cross-browser testing
- Git version control in a team setting
- Ability to communicate clearly with non-technical clients

Bonus points

- Shopify/Liquid experience
- Figma-to-code workflow experience
- Basic Linux server administration (cPanel, nginx)
- Google Analytics and Search Console experience

Compensation

$60,000-$78,000 CAD, hybrid (Mississauga office 1-2 days/week), benefits after 3 months, profit-share after year one.
